description:
Apply text edits to a stored design and commit a new version of it.

The store is configuration management: the edit is committed back to the SAME
design_id (git tracks the diff), not saved as a new file. Apply it onto a product
with the browser courier. Only the words change — fonts, layout, and images are
preserved, and the heavy image is never moved (the design keeps referencing the
same content-addressed assets).

The box does not resize, so keep each new text within roughly ±10% of the
character count of the layer it replaces (see `chars` from get_design_text);
longer copy overflows and the merchant fixes it by hand.

commit_message.description:
A specific description of WHAT changed and WHY — a real commit
message, not a placeholder like 'save this' or 'update'. Required.

design_id.description: The design to edit, from roastify_list_designs.

edits.description:
A map of {layer_id: new_text}, using ids from roastify_get_design_text.
Include every layer that should change, including ones that repeat a
value or embed it in a longer blurb. A JSON object string is also
accepted (some MCP clients serialize object args that way).

label.description: Rename the design (optional). Defaults to keeping its current label.

npub.description: Required. Your Nostr public key (npub1...) for credit billing.

version_tag.description:
The NEXT semver version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH, e.g. 1.3.0, no 'v') — call
roastify_list_design_versions and increment. Required; reusing one is refused.

name: roastify_update_design_text
title: Roastify Update Design Text
